stories.summary: The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC for Plan B: Terraform and the free Update 1.1 are out now on Steam. Check out the Plan B: Terraform trailer for the sci-fi planetary base-building sim game for another look at what to expect with the Worlds of Fire and Water DLC, and the free update 1.1. The Worlds of Fire and Water DLC features Fire World, with constant volcano eruptions, mineral-rich basalt, geysers and condensators. It also features Water World, with a few tiny islands a world covered in water, along with polluted water and filters. The free update 1.1 features a tech tree, ugrades, dynamic ice cap, shade and mirror satellites, ice comets, sea plants and plankton, water farm, small ship, airship, GHG neutralization factory, drone extractor, and floating extractor.
